boards.title: Your First Weekend at Salve Regina University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend route that connects practical campus landmarks, student resources, and Salve’s Cliff Walk setting.

cards.title: Start by spotting Ochre Court
cards.subtitle: Salve’s main administration building on Ochre Point Avenue
cards.notes: Use the exterior as an early campus landmark, then walk the nearby grounds to orient yourself before heading toward student-life stops.
cards.short_summary: A historic mansion that anchors the university’s Ochre Point setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve identifies Ochre Court as its main administration building, situated along Newport’s Cliff Walk.
cards.access_notes: The page identifies it as an administration building; use public exterior and event access only.

cards.title: Make Gerety Hall your activity checkpoint
cards.subtitle: Student Engagement hub, Gerety Hall
cards.notes: Check the Student Engagement information and current campus listings, then use the hall as a reference point for the weekend’s scheduled activities.
cards.short_summary: A campus-events hub with designated student gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve calls renovated Gerety Hall the heart of campus events and student activities and lists Student Engagement there.
cards.access_notes: Listed Gerety Hall hours are 8:30 a.m.–midnight weekdays and 2 p.m.–midnight weekends; confirm event access separately.

cards.title: Find Miley Hall’s campus essentials
cards.subtitle: First-year residence and dining hub
cards.notes: Locate the dining hall, bookstore, and student-service offices now so everyday needs are easy to find once the first week starts.
cards.short_summary: A first-year living community that groups dining and practical student resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve describes Miley Hall as a hub containing dining, Miley Mart/Starbucks, the bookstore, and several student-service offices.
cards.access_notes: Residence-hall access may be restricted; use dining and offices according to university access policies.

cards.title: Get acquainted with McKillop Library
cards.subtitle: Library and academic-support destination
cards.notes: Walk through to identify the circulation desk and study areas, then note the academic services based on the first and second floors.
cards.short_summary: The campus library also houses multiple academic-support offices.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve’s offices directory lists McKillop Library along with the Academic Center for Excellence, Writing Center, accessibility services, and other services.
cards.source_title: Campus Offices and Services | Salve Regina University
cards.access_notes: Library borrowing is available to active Salve students with a valid SRU ID.

cards.title: Pause at Our Lady of Mercy Chapel
cards.subtitle: Central campus chapel and interfaith space
cards.notes: Visit respectfully for a quiet reset, and make a note of the first-floor interfaith prayer room and the student spaces in Mercy Commons below.
cards.short_summary: A chapel with worship, reflection, and student-community spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve states that the chapel has an interfaith prayer room and that its lower-level Mercy Commons includes student space to study, relax, and meet.
cards.source_title: Center for Spiritual Life | Salve Regina University
cards.access_notes: The chapel’s Masses are open to the campus and greater Newport communities; scheduled services are not offered during summer and winter breaks.

cards.title: Locate the multifaith prayer space
cards.subtitle: Miley/Walgreen courtyard
cards.notes: Add this to your quiet-place map for a daytime pause between move-in tasks, meals, or orientation activities.
cards.short_summary: A daily open space for reflection across faith traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve says the multifaith prayer space is in the Miley/Walgreen courtyard and is open daily from 6 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Center for Spiritual Life | Salve Regina University
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open daily, 6 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Find the Rodgers Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Campus fitness and athletics destination
cards.notes: Locate the recreation center while you are mapping campus, then check university programming or facility rules before planning a workout or game.
cards.short_summary: The named location for Salve athletics and fitness services.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve’s offices directory lists Athletics and the Fitness Center at Rodgers Recreation Center.
cards.source_title: Campus Offices and Services | Salve Regina University
cards.access_notes: Confirm recreation-center hours and eligibility with the university before use.

cards.title: Note the Young Building for public programs
cards.subtitle: Home of the Pell Center, 518 Bellevue Avenue
cards.notes: Keep this address in mind when browsing talks and lectures; choose an announced event that fits your weekend rather than assuming daily public access.
cards.short_summary: A Bellevue Avenue building that houses the Pell Center and hosts programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve’s event venue page says the Young Building houses the Pell Center and hosts special events and lectures.
cards.access_notes: Attend only events with a published listing and follow the event’s admission instructions.

cards.title: Take a daylight look at the Cliff Walk setting
cards.subtitle: Historic public walk beside Salve’s coastal campus
cards.notes: Choose a daylight segment that suits conditions, stay on the marked route, and treat it as a scenic orientation walk rather than a shortcut across campus.
cards.short_summary: The coastal walk that runs alongside Salve’s campus setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve states that its campus is located along Newport’s historic Cliff Walk.
cards.access_notes: Use only open, marked public sections and check local conditions before walking.

cards.title: End with a late-evening campus food option
cards.subtitle: Gerety Hall
cards.notes: If you want food after an activity, check The Nest’s current service status and select an available item; hours can change around breaks and operations.
cards.short_summary: A Gerety Hall dining option with an officially listed late-night service window.
cards.evidence_claim: Salve’s 2025–26 student handbook lists The Nest in Gerety Hall as serving daily from 11:30 a.m. to 11:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The handbook lists daily service until 11:30 p.m.; verify same-day operations and break schedules before going.
